configuration.model: variance DN^2 = a*signal DN+b; nonnegative least squares and unconstrained diagnostic
configuration.weighting: equal total weight per disjoint pair, equal ROI weights within pair
configuration.reference_black: median CFA/ROI means of same-ISO user-declared blacks at 1/200s; require stable dark pair per plane; dark variance diagnostic not forced as intercept
configuration.validation: leave one entire pair out; not an independent unseen dataset
configuration.units: decoder DN and DN^2; no conversion to electrons or normalized NoiseProfile

planes.dark_identity_source: user-declared blacks folder, not independently certified
